feeds.title: Glasgow With Kids
feeds.description: I'm Lynn and likes to get out & about, and she is currently trying out anything baby/toddler related she can find in and around my local area, which I am documenting here in an attempt to help others find things to do with their little ones, and to meet other new mums & babies.

feeds.title: Celts Are Here
feeds.description: Celts Are Here is a dedicated unofficial news blog for the famous Glasgow Celtic FC. We have a team of dedicated authors who are Celtic daft and who have their fingers of the pulse of Celtic news. Top Celtic Blog giving you the latest news and views from the Celtic Family.

feeds.title: Glasgow Airport Blog
feeds.description: Glasgow Airport has over 30 airlines serving approximately 130 destinations worldwide. Glasgow is Scotland's principal long-haul airport as well as Scotland's largest charter hub and it serves more Scottish destinations than any other airport and is a key component of Scotland's transport infrastructure.

feeds.title: Ellis Tuesday
feeds.description: Ellis Tuesday is a beauty, fashion & lifestyle blog brought to you by Ellis, a self-confessed shopaholic from Scotland with an overwhelming stash of beauty products and a love for all things leopard print. A blog about beauty, travel, lifestyle, and fashion from a twenty-something Glasgow girl.

feeds.title: Glasgow Theatre Blog
feeds.description: The aim of the blog is to publicise and review arts events in Glasgow and the Greater Glasgow area. The best place for news, interviews and reviews of theatre in Glasgow, Scotland and beyond.

feeds.title: Go Bike
feeds.description: GoBike is a campaign group aiming to promote cycling by campaigning for safer cycling and better infrastructure in Glasgow.

feeds.title: GSA Archives
feeds.description: The Glasgow School of Art's archives and collections are an outstanding resource for the study of art, design, architecture and art education.They comprise of a wide range of material from GSA's institutional archives to artworks and architectural drawings, textile pieces, plaster casts, photographs and furniture. Our holdings also include a large number of items by Charles Rennie Mackintosh, giving us one of the largest Mackintosh collections held in public ownership.

feeds.title: Everything Flows
feeds.description: Everything Flows is all about being a music lover in Glasgow - gig reviews, ramblings, discoveries and musings that hopefully capture some of what is going on in the ever diverse Glasgow Music Scene - be it established, touring or up and coming acts, as well as delving into my record collection from time to time.

feeds.title: Ola Molik Blog
feeds.description: Ola Molik is specialized in newborn photography, but also do pregnancy, toddler, kids and parent and child sessions. He is a photographer approved by BANPAS (Baby and Newborn of Photography Association) for newborn safety, and professionalism, so one can be confident your baby is in safe hands.

feeds.title: Glasgow Warriors Blog
feeds.description: The unofficial fansite for the Glasgow Warriors Rugby team, including news, player profiles and match reports.

feeds.title: Travels with a Kilt Blog
feeds.description: Travels with a Kilt is a travel blog and itineraries with advice for travelling Scotland and covering the whole country with loads of castles, Outlander, sports, mountains, whisky and many more.

feeds.title: The Laird Report
feeds.description: The real Glaswegian working class voice in the independence debate read by thousands, the BBC and other related media, secured the first criminal conviction against one of the seven top cybernats outed by the Daily Mail.

feeds.title: Aye Lined

feeds.title: Midlife Smarts
feeds.description: Here in Midlife Smarts, one will find a guide to (Mid)Life - from never quite being bikini-body ready to have all your best (and worst) ideas at 3.17 am - precisely. Rest assured, there will be no fashion tips, makeup demonstrations or overt pouting, but hopefully the odd chuckle and the occasional outburst of filthy laughter. Follow to keep up with the blog.

feeds.title: GrabTheThistle: The Toryglen Residents' Blog
feeds.description: Toryglen residents holding Thistle Housing Association's corrupt management to account as of 31 October 2019, The Scottish Housing Regulator has announced it is to be closed down. Millions of pounds wasted and lost by Thistle management who hadn't a clue but had enough savvy to pay themselves huge and undeserved wages.

feeds.title: Top Table Photography
feeds.description: Top Table Photography packages come with full day coverage as standard, meaning they are there as long as you want them to be - from the bridal preparations in the morning untill the dancing in the evening. You will also receive a copy of all of your photos on a disc for you to print and share as you like. Not to mention that your wedding will be photographed by both Chris and Ewan.

feeds.title: James vs. Burger | Glasgow's Burger Blog
feeds.description: James vs. Burger is the Ultimate Burger Journey; on a quest to uncover Scotland's Greatest Burger and Great Burgers further afield. From reviews to recipes, James vs Burger is your one-stop Burger resource.

As well as interiors, she love to travel and you will occasionally find snippets of this on the blog as well as family life, cooking, and Nordic Design, which features a lot on Ollie & Sebs Haus.

feeds.title: Glasgow FrontRunners
feeds.description: Glasgow FrontRunners is community based road-running group with strong links to Glasgow's Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual and Transgender (LGBT) community and friends. They have a full range of abilities, from absolute beginners, to advanced competitive runners who undertake half-marathons & marathons.

feeds.title: Nicole Corbett
